args.headline: Bridge adds a withdrawal timelock
args.comment: Users must now wait two days for withdrawals, which gives watchers time to submit fraud proofs before settlement.

args.headline: Protocol adds an emergency pause
args.comment: The pause affects new deposits only. Existing borrowers can still repay debt and withdraw unencumbered collateral.

args.headline: Protocol reduces leverage limits
args.comment: This is a reduction in maximum leverage for new positions, not forced liquidation of existing positions. The distinction matters for current borrowers.

args.headline: Governance raises a bridge's transfer cap
args.comment: I disagree with raising the cap before adding independent watchers. A single compromised validator still authorizes withdrawals under the current design.
